drills.prompt: Eu sou engenheiro(a) de software.
answers: I am a software engineer.
drills.explanation: Use “a” antes de uma profissão singular.

drills.prompt: Ela trabalha remotamente de São Paulo.
answers: She works remotely from São Paulo.
drills.explanation: No presente simples, he/she/it recebe -s: works.

drills.prompt: Nós terminamos o deploy ontem.
answers: We finished the deployment yesterday.
We finished the deploy yesterday.
drills.explanation: “Yesterday” indica passado com tempo definido: finished.

drills.prompt: Você já usou Terraform?
answers: Have you ever used Terraform?
drills.explanation: Pergunta sobre experiência: Have + sujeito + ever + particípio.

drills.prompt: Ele não gosta de reuniões longas.
answers: He does not like long meetings.
He doesn't like long meetings.
drills.explanation: Use does not + verbo na forma base com he/she/it.

drills.prompt: Eu tenho sete anos de experiência com .NET.
answers: I have seven years of experience with .NET.
I have 7 years of experience with .NET.
drills.explanation: Para duração de experiência, “I have … years of experience” é natural.

drills.prompt: Onde fica o escritório?
answers: Where is the office?
drills.explanation: Com BE, inverta verbo e sujeito: Where + is + the office?

drills.prompt: Quantas pessoas há na sua equipe?
answers: How many people are there on your team?
How many people are there in your team?
drills.explanation: Use how many com substantivos contáveis, como people.

drills.prompt: Por que você quer trabalhar no exterior?
answers: Why do you want to work abroad?
drills.explanation: No presente simples, use Why + do + sujeito + verbo base.

drills.prompt: Eu trabalharei nisso amanhã.
answers: I will work on it tomorrow.
drills.explanation: Use will + verbo base para o futuro.

drills.prompt: Eu nunca trabalhei com Kafka.
answers: I have never worked with Kafka.
drills.explanation: Use have + never + particípio para falar de experiência até agora.

drills.prompt: De quem é esse código?
answers: Whose code is this?
drills.explanation: Whose indica posse e vem antes do substantivo.

drills.prompt: Resposta: “I am from Brazil.”
drills.instruction: Pergunte sobre o lugar de origem.
answers: Where are you from?
drills.explanation: Where pergunta sobre lugar. Com BE: Where + are + you + from?

drills.prompt: Resposta: “I started coding in 2018.”
drills.instruction: Pergunte quando a pessoa começou a programar.
answers: When did you start coding?
drills.explanation: Com did, o verbo principal volta à forma base: start.

drills.prompt: Resposta: “I work with a team of six engineers.”
drills.instruction: Pergunte com quem a pessoa trabalha.
answers: Who do you work with?
drills.explanation: Use do + sujeito + verbo base no presente simples.

drills.prompt: Resposta: “I prefer the second option.”
drills.instruction: Pergunte qual opção a pessoa prefere.
answers: Which option do you prefer?
drills.explanation: Which é usado quando há um conjunto limitado de opções.

drills.prompt: Resposta: “I have ten years of experience.”
drills.instruction: Pergunte quantos anos de experiência a pessoa tem.
answers: How many years of experience do you have?
drills.explanation: Years é contável: use how many.

drills.prompt: Did you spoke with the hiring manager?
answers: Did you speak with the hiring manager?
Did you speak with the manager?
drills.explanation: Depois de did, use o verbo na forma base: speak.

drills.prompt: He don't like long meetings.
answers: He doesn't like long meetings.
He does not like long meetings.
drills.explanation: Na 3ª pessoa do singular, use doesn't/does not.

drills.prompt: I have see this issue before.
answers: I have seen this issue before.
drills.explanation: O particípio de see é seen: see / saw / seen.

drills.prompt: She will not comes tomorrow.
answers: She will not come tomorrow.
She won't come tomorrow.
drills.explanation: Depois de will/won't, use a forma base do verbo.

drills.prompt: We was at the office yesterday.
drills.instruction: Corrija o verbo BE no passado.
answers: We were at the office yesterday.
drills.explanation: Com we, use were no passado de BE.

drills.prompt: Did you went to the client meeting?
answers: Did you go to the client meeting?
drills.explanation: Depois de did, use go, não went.

drills.prompt: She has wrote the technical documentation.
answers: She has written the technical documentation.
drills.explanation: O particípio de write é written: write / wrote / written.
